message.content:
Here’s a mix of classics, modern hits, and hidden gems you might enjoy for a spooky Friday night:

| # | Title | Year | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|--------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** (1980) | A psychological thriller with an iconic score and chilling atmosphere. |
| 2 | **Get Out** (2017) | A smart social satire wrapped in a tense horror package. |
| 3 | **Hereditary** (2018) | A slow‑burn dread that culminates in a truly shocking finale. |
| 4 | **Midsommar** (2019) | A daylight horror that turns the genre on its head. |
| 5 | **It Follows** (2014) | A fresh take on the “invisible threat” trope with a haunting soundtrack. |
| 6 | **The Babadook** (2014) | Psychological terror that feels personal and deeply unsettling. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** (2018) | Suspense built around silence—perfect for a tense movie marathon. |
| 8 | **The Conjuring** (2013) | A well‑crafted supernatural story with plenty of jump‑scares. |
| 9 | **The Witch** (2015) | A slow‑burn period horror that rewards patience with a powerful payoff. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** (2012) | A meta‑commentary on horror tropes that still delivers genuine scares. |

Feel free to pick one or two from each era for a varied fright fest!
